monogamian.translation: a. 一夫一妻的, [动]单配的, 一雌一雄的

monogamic.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or involving, monogamy.
a. Of or pertaining to the Monogamia; having a simple
   flower with united anthers.
monogamic.translation: a. 一夫一妻的, 单配的, 一雌一雄的

monogamist.definition: n. someone who practices monogamy (one spouse at a time)

monogamous.definition: a. (used of relationships and of individuals) having one mate

monogamously.translation:
一夫一妻制地
主张一夫一妻地
【动】单配地, 一雌一雄地

monogamy.definition: n. having only one spouse at a time
monogamy.translation:
n. 一夫一妻制
[医] 单配

monogastric.definition: a. Having but a single stomach.

monogenean.translation: n. 单殖亚纲动物,单殖吸虫

monogenesis.definition: n. asexual reproduction by the production and release of spores
monogenesis.translation:
n. 无性生殖
[医] 单性生殖, 无性生殖, 单细胞原论

monogenetic.definition:
a. One in genesis; resulting from one process of
   formation; -- used of a mountain range.
a. Relating to, or involving, monogenesis; as, the
   monogenetic school of physiologists, who admit but one cell as the
   source of all beings.

monogenic.definition: s. of or relating to an inheritable character that is controlled by a single pair of genes

monogenism.definition:
n. The theory or doctrine that the human races have a
   common origin, or constitute a single species.

monogenist.definition:
n. One who maintains that the human races are all of one
   species; -- opposed to polygenist.

monogenous.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to monogenesis; as, monogenous, or
   asexual, reproduction.

monogeny.definition:
n. Monogenesis.
n. The doctrine that the members of the human race have all
   a common origin.

monogerminal.translation: [医] 单胚性的, 一卵生的

monoglot.translation: a. & n.使用单一语言的(人)

monoglycol salicylate.translation: [医] 水杨酸乙二醇酯, 斯派罗萨

monogony.translation: 单性生殖, 无性生殖

monogram.definition: n. a graphic symbol consisting of 2 or more letters combined (usually your initials); printed on stationery or embroidered on clothing
monogram.translation:
n. 字母组合
[法] 交织文字, 字母图案

monogrammed.translation: a. 有交织字母(或花押字)的

monogrammic.definition: a. Of, pertaining to, or resembling, a monogram.

monogramming.translation:
n. 字并合
v. 把交织字母印于（monogram的ing形式）

monograms.definition: n. a graphic symbol consisting of 2 or more letters combined (usually your initials); printed on stationery or embroidered on clothing
monograms.translation: n. 字母组合( monogram的复数形式 )

monograph.definition: n. a detailed and documented treatise on a particular subject
monograph.translation:
n. 专题论文, 专著, 专刊
vt. 写专题论文

monographer.definition: n. A writer of a monograph.

monographical.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a monograph, or to a monography;
   as, a monographic writing; a monographic picture.
monographical.translation: a. 专题的, 专题性的

monographics.definition:
plural of monographic
a. Alt. of Monographical
monographics.translation: (monographic 的复数) a. 专题论文的

monographist.definition: n. One who writes a monograph.

monographs.definition: n. a detailed and documented treatise on a particular subject
monographs.translation: n. 专著, 专论( monograph的复数形式 )

monography.definition:
n. Representation by lines without color; an outline
   drawing.
n. A monograph.

monogynian.definition:
a. Pertaining to the Monogynia; monogynous.
n. One of the Monogynia.

monogynous.definition: s. having one head or chief wife at a time (along with concubines)

monogyny.definition: n. having only one wife at a time
